title: Sentry control views on the tank's keys: 1 map, 2 PoV over the barrels, 3 third person
context: Owner: show a little of the rotating barrels in the PoV view, try a third-person view too, and put the shortcuts on 1/2/3 consistent with the tank.
outcome: sentry-pilot.js keeps the aim optic on the mount and moves only the camera eye: PoV sits 0.34 cells behind and 0.12 above the optic so the barrel tips fill the bottom of the frame; third person sits 2.4 cells behind and 1.35 above, looking along the aim. The tank's mapping is used (1 map, 2 first person, 3 third), active only in story mode where the digits no longer pick weapons. The acceptance hook exposes view() and the story-world run captures third, map and PoV frames.
alternatives: Owner's draft 1 PoV, 2 map, 3 third: not used, the tank already teaches 1 map, 2 PoV, 3 third.
evidence: node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: PASS story-world-third, story-world-map, plus the earlier chain
